---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for OpenMind
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## // FEATURE_SUMMARY
A clear, one-sentence description of the feature.

## // PROBLEM_IT_SOLVES
What problem does this solve? What's missing right now?

## // PROPOSED_SOLUTION
How should it work? What should the user experience be?

## // ALTERNATIVES_CONSIDERED
Any other approaches you considered?

## // ROADMAP_FIT
Does this connect to an item on the roadmap? (v1.1 Topic Library, v1.2 Manipulation Score, etc.)

## // ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT
Mockups, examples from other projects, or any other context.
